en: Vintage monochrome postcard view of a European town square with historic multi‑story buildings lining a market place and a street leading off to the right. A fountain with a basin stands in the foreground on the left, while ornate facades and shopfronts with awnings line Chemnitzer Straße. Small figures of pedestrians are visible on the street. Printed red text at the top identifies the location, and smaller shop signage appears on the buildings.
